comment: Browser dependencies LUCID fetches from a CDN by default. They are NOT
committed; run `python3 scripts/offline_deps.py install` to vendor them into
lib/ for offline use. Everything else LUCID needs (h5wasm, sleap-io.js,
mediabunny, pako) is already committed under lib/.
This file is the single source of truth for three consumers:
scripts/offline_deps.py  -- what to fetch, verify and extract
server.py --offline      -- which CDN URL maps to which local path
`offline_deps.py check`  -- that the pinned versions in source agree
`integrity` is the npm registry's own dist.integrity value. `assert` entries
are behavioral checks: they pin the API/global LUCID actually depends on, so
an upstream that silently drops it fails the install instead of the app.
NOT mapped on purpose: lib/sleap-io/chunk-X76PRJK6.js:8697's MP4BOX_CDN
(unpkg mp4box@0.5.4). Its loadMp4box() returns globalThis.MP4Box before ever
reaching that fetch, and index.html's mp4box script tag always sets the
global -- so it is unreachable. Mapping it would also substitute 0.5.2 for
the 0.5.4 it names. See the Offline mode section in CLAUDE.md.

three.why: 3D viewport. 0.147 is the last release with examples/js/ classic scripts.

assert.why: attaches to the THREE global; ui/viewport3d.js reads it from there

mp4box.why: MP4 demux for the HTML5/WebCodecs decode path in loading/video.js.

dockview-core.licenseFileNote: The 6.6.1 npm tarball ships NO LICENSE file. MIT per its package.json; copyright mathuo (github.com/mathuo/dockview). Recorded in lib/OFFLINE_LICENSES.md instead.
dockview-core.why: Pane docking. Pinned: 7.x renamed api.onUnhandledDragOverEvent -> onUnhandledDragOver, which silently broke docking when the CDN cache refreshed.

assert.why: the 6.6.x API name; 7.x renamed it. Its absence is exactly the silent breakage the pin exists to prevent.

yaml.why: lib/sleap-io/chunk-X76PRJK6.js has a STATIC `import YAML from "yaml"`. If this specifier does not resolve the whole session-I/O chunk fails to parse and the app never starts -- this is the one dependency whose absence is fatal rather than degrading.

assert.why: index.js only re-exports; the whole browser/ subtree must come along
the re-export target index.js resolves to
